mathematical_scope: Necessary two-stage invariant: if A=S2 Q P S1 satisfies AZ=DA, then Q P (S1 Z S1^-1) P^-1 Q^-1=S2^-1 D S2. Diagonal similarity leaves diagonal entries unchanged, and permutation similarity permutes them, so the diagonal multisets must match. A mismatch excludes every intermediate permutation and invertible diagonal for these fixed S1,S2 in the chosen field; equality is not sufficient. The two component formulas correctly compute diagonal entries of the conjugates.
input_and_guard_coverage: mats trusts apply/inverse without explicitly verifying mutual inverses or output lengths. diag_modulation_conjugate does not require N|(MOD-1) or validate primitive order; unsupported n uses floor exponentiation. certify_two_stage accepts only named variants by dictionary lookup, with no friendly validation. Generic tree stage dimensions may extend beyond the root assumptions. Fixed sampled constructors in run use dyadic n8..128.
cost_and_scaling: mats materializes N forward and inverse columns, O(N²) storage and O(N·apply_cost). Each diagonal computation uses N² products plus modular powers for modulation. Sorting adds O(N log N). This avoids N! permutation search but is still dense quadratic storage/work (assuming linear stage apply).
test_evidence: Phase13 test uses both repeated explicit sums and separate apply-based conjugation at n8, then veto cases at n8,16,32 for six fixed variant pairs. All these tests are below unittest.main and missed on direct invocation. No tests where diagonal multisets match but synthesis fails, or unsupported root dimensions.
dependency_identity: Assigned haar_adapter_mod; identity-only unitary_mixer aff6a16c…. Bare import from sibling phase12 is not established for standalone execution. Field embedding for sqrt2 is guarded by assigned modular adapter.

findings.finding: Missing divisibility/exact-root-order guard can construct a modulation matrix that is not the intended N-th-root Fourier D for unsupported N; a mismatch then does not answer the intended Fourier problem.

The quantifier is arbitrary intermediate Q,P but fixed sampled endpoint stages. It cannot be promoted to all endpoint graph orders, strengths, products of three or more stages, or an arbitrary Fourier algorithm.

acceptance_boundary: Accept the exact necessary invariant and fixed-instance veto methodology within field/root/inverse assumptions. A matching multiset never certifies successful synthesis.
